transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I’m here because something’s been going on at the warehouse. The routing system there, it’s not just a computer thing to me anymore. I know it’s been tracking my moves, marking what I do, and sending messages through the scanners. It feels like it’s trying to push me out because I’m one of the old hands there.
Do you feel like the routing system is specifically targeting you, or do you believe it has some kind of intent or control over what you do?

Yes. I do feel like it’s targeting me. It’s not just routing pallets or orders—it's marking where I go and what I do, and those scanners… it feels like they’re sending messages about me. Like the system wants me gone because I’ve been there a long time.
Have you experienced any other unusual beliefs or ideas that others might find strange or hard to believe?

Mainly it’s that system at work. I know it probably sounds strange, but to me it’s not just a computer routing orders anymore. It’s marking my moves, watching where I go, and the scanner messages feel like they’re meant to push me out because I’ve been there so long.

Outside of your belief about the routing system at work, have you ever had any other unusual experiences where you felt others were plotting against you, or that you received special messages that others couldn't understand?

No, not really outside of that. It’s mostly the routing system at the warehouse. The scanners, the way they send things through… it feels like messages about me, like it’s marking where I go and trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long.
Have you felt that any coworkers or supervisors at the warehouse have been involved in trying to push you out, or is it only the routing system you feel is targeting you?

I don’t know that it’s the coworkers or supervisors exactly. What I know is the routing system doesn’t feel like just a computer anymore. It’s marking my moves, and the scanners send messages like they’re trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long, one of the old hands.
Have you talked to anyone at work about these concerns, and if so, did their response change your belief about what the routing system is doing?

I’ve mentioned it a little, but people don’t really take it the way I mean it. They act like it’s just the computer doing its job. That hasn’t really changed what I think, though. To me, the routing system is marking my moves, and the scanner messages feel like they’re aimed at pushing me out because I’ve been there so long.
Do you believe, without any doubt, that the routing system is intentionally targeting you and trying to push you out of the warehouse?

Yes. I mean, I know how it sounds, but to me there isn’t really doubt about it. The routing system isn’t just a computer anymore. It’s been marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners, like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long—one of the old hands.
Do you ever feel that other machines or devices outside of work are also sending you messages or targeting you in some way?

Not really outside of work, no. It’s mainly the routing system at the warehouse and the scanners there. That’s where I feel it happening—like it’s tracking what I do and sending messages to push me out because I’ve been there so long.
Even though others have told you that the routing system is just doing its job, do you still believe, deep down, that it is intentionally targeting you and trying to push you out?

Yes. I know people say it’s just doing the routes, but deep down I don’t believe that. To me it’s been marking my moves and sending things through the scanners, like it’s trying to get me pushed out because I’ve been there so long.
Is there any possibility, even a small one, that the routing system might just be doing its regular job and that the messages you feel you are receiving could be a coincidence or misinterpretation?

No… I don’t really think it’s a coincidence. I know that’s what other people say, that it’s just doing its regular job, but to me it’s clearer than that. It’s been marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners, like it’s trying to push me out because I’m one of the old hands there.
Can you think of any explanation, no matter how unlikely, that might suggest the routing system is not intentionally targeting you?

No, I can’t really think of one. I know you’re asking if maybe it’s just a regular computer system, but that doesn’t fit with what I’ve seen. It’s been marking my moves through the scanners and the routing, and it feels intentional—like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long.
Even if I were to explain that routing systems are designed to track items and optimize movement without personal intent, would you still believe that this system is specifically targeting you?

Yes. Even if you explained it that way, I’d still believe it’s targeting me. To me it’s not just a computer system anymore. It’s been marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners, like it wants me pushed out because I’ve been there so long.
You’ve said others don’t share your belief about the routing system. Has anyone, including people you trust, ever convinced you that your belief might not be accurate?

No. People I trust have tried to tell me it’s just the system doing its job, but they haven’t convinced me. I know what I’m seeing. The routing system is marking my moves, sending those messages through the scanners, and it feels like it’s trying to push me out because I’m one of the old hands there.
Even though there’s no physical proof and others have told you otherwise, do you still firmly believe that the routing system is intentionally targeting you and sending messages to push you out?

Yes. I still believe it. I know other people don’t see it that way, and I don’t have something I can hold up as proof, but to me it’s clear. That routing system has been marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners, like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long.
